title: NetDecoyEvent
description: Standardized event schema for NetDecoy honeypot telemetry

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the event (e.g. evt_1712660000_a1b2c3)

source_ip.description: IP address of the origin visitor / attacker

page.description: Trap or entry point name (e.g. login, admin_portal, phpmyadmin, env_leak, api_v1, ssh_portal)

action.description: Observed action (e.g. failed_login, sqli_probe, directory_traversal, credential_stuffing, file_download, payload_injection)

event_type.description: Category of the event (e.g. authentication, reconnaissance, exploitation, privilege_escalation, data_exfiltration)

payload.description: Arbitrary captured payload data, parameters, form inputs, headers, or query strings

geo.description: Geographical enrichment data (city, country, latitude, longitude, isp)
